description: ACES calibration samples: periodic primitive unit cells, t/a [0.08, 0.12, 0.16], Re [5.0, 6.0], Air at 320 K, 96 voxels per cell. Campaign 3: pin the primitive Mach boundary (Mach/Re ~ 0.023 measured in campaign 2 -> Re 5 ~ Mach 0.115 safe, Re 6 ~ Mach 0.138 borderline). Cases over Mach 0.15 are expected to be honestly rejected by cfd-collect; that IS the boundary measurement.
hypothesis: Primitive Mach ceiling sits between Re 5 and Re 6.5 (Mach/Re ~ 0.023 from campaign 2); the fitted primitive factors (D30, constant 0.8694/3.9413) then hold over the full citable range Re <= ~6.
expected: dpdx and H1 h per case (rows carry boundary uniform_heat_flux); fitted with `aces calibrate`, which takes the boundary from the rows.
rd_activity: ACES fast-tier calibration of TPMS heat-exchanger cores
